name: @noesis-vision/noesis
description: Noesis service — one stdio MCP process per agent session, serving the knowledge graph in .noesis/ and the browser UI

scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../frontend build:spa && NODE_ENV=production bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist --target bun --production --banner '#!/usr/bin/env bun' --entry-naming '[name].[ext]' && bun run scripts/copy-ui.ts
scripts.start:debug: bun run --cwd ../frontend build:spa && PORT=3000 NOESIS_OPEN_BROWSER=0 bun --inspect --watch src/main.ts
scripts.test:e2e: bun run --cwd ../frontend build:spa && bun test test/e2e
